lines.text: Many learners say: It is seven o'clock thirty.
O'clock is only for the full hour.

data.why: O'clock is only for the full hour.

native.tip: 中文说“七点三十分”，“点”后面直接接分钟，所以容易把 o'clock 放在中间。英语的 o'clock 只用于整点。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “It is seven o'clock thirty.”😅 英语的 o'clock 只用于整点，几点几分直接说 seven thirty：“It is seven thirty.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“It is seven thirty.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Use o'clock only for the full hour, like seven o'clock.
en.caption: Do you say “It is seven o'clock thirty.” 😅 Use o'clock only for the full hour, so say seven thirty: “It is seven thirty.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
